assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode
Each acquisition cycle included a survey scan (350–1250 m/z) of 250 ms and a maximum of 25 MS2 spectra (100–1500 m/z).
labeling: No labeling reagents mentioned for quantification; standard LC-MS/MS used for identification of crosslinks.
enrichment: selected fractions were crosslinked by adding fresh DTSSP or DSSO
Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: DSSO modifications (K) (monolink ammonia and water quench, intra-peptide and inter-peptide crosslink) were used as variable modifications

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) study using DTSSP and DSSO reagents to map protein-protein interactions in chaperone complexes. While the study discusses ubiquitination, the MS analysis focuses on the crosslinks (complexome) rather than enriching for ubiquitin remnants (diGly).

scope: We generated complexes between the chaperones (Hsp70 or Hsp90), the cochaperone CHIP and, as substrate, a p53 variant containing the GST protein (p53-TMGST).
The sample was loaded onto a Ni-NTA agarose column (HisTrap FF 5 mL, GE Healthcare)
Purified DTSSP-crosslinked complexes were precipitated using the methanol/chloroform method, and the protein pellet was dissolved in 10 µL 8 M urea, 25 mM NH4HCO3.
The crosslinked complex was trypsin-digested and the resulting peptides analysed by liquid chromatography coupled to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS consisted of recombinant protein complexes (Hsp70/Hsp90, CHIP, and p53-TMGST) that were purified via Ni-NTA affinity chromatography and gel filtration, then chemically crosslinked.

evidence: we generated several of the Hsp70- and Hsp90-based complexes that form during such degradation, and determined their 3D structure using a combination of electron microscopy (EM), image processing, and crosslinking mass spectrometry (XL-MS).
The crosslinked complex was trypsin-digested and the resulting peptides analysed by liquid chromatography coupled to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a structural proteomics study using crosslinking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to map interactions within reconstituted protein complexes (Hsp70/Hsp90, CHIP, and p53-TMGST). It is not a differential expression or perturbation study comparing treated vs control biological samples; rather, it is a biochemical characterization of protein-protein interactions. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
